text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The summer training camp begins.
Yet, as if to dampen our spirits right from the start...
certain news was brought to light.

text_block_list.name: Newscaster
text_block_list.text:
Now, moving on to the next news story.
Regarding this year's Mile Championship Nambu Hai...

text_block_list.name: Newscaster
text_block_list.text:
Since the local venue does not yet have the capacity
to host a major event like a GⅠ race, this year's edition
will be held at Tokyo Racecourse instead.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Huh... Did you know about this, Trainy...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...I was a bit worried.
That there was a possibility it might not
be held as scheduled."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Following this decision, I'm also worried about
Transcend's motivation, but...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. But... I guess this is just one of those things
that can't be helped, in its own way.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
There are probably people who aren't in the mood
to watch races right now, and when I think about
how they feel...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
I can no longer offer words of encouragement...
but I won't hurt anyone anymore, either...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: In other words... it's a package deal.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Transcend's expression looked more relieved
than disappointed.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I know you don't want to do anything unnecessary.
I understand that feeling, but..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Whooosh, whooosh...)

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Summer training camp...
Maybe it's a good time... to think about a few things.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
(Let's take another look.
What can we do to truly fulfill our feelings...?)

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
(My rivals...
Accu-san... Espo-n...)

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
(Furioso, Falco-chan...
I thought if I analyzed everyone's runs and pushed
beyond my imagination, I'd finally feel fulfilled.)

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Still... everything had changed.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
No matter how much I race now, I can't feel the thrill anymore.
Neither I nor my friends can even smile.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: What I need to be thinking about right now isn't my running. That's why...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Whirrr... click)

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: A memory card storing all the data up until now...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: This is... just...!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Ngh...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Plop)

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
It's fine this way.
It won't be of any use to me from now on anyway.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"Guess I was just being far too shallow in my reading.
From the very start..."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
(Biodegradable cards...
Everything dissolves and fades away...)

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: (The data inside, and our failures too, all of it...)

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Yep, okay! That clears things up.
Let's scrap it and start over from square one.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Time to re-search, y'know?
What I can do, why I run.
And...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Let's give them our full support.
The races are important, but... this is even more so!
